from itertools import permutations

# Define the size of the chessboard
n = 22

# Define the fixed assignments
fixed_assignments = {11: 8, 16: 14, 18: 11, 21: 13}

# Generate all possible permutations of columns for the queens
for p in permutations(range(n)):
    # Check if the permutation is consistent with the fixed assignments
    if all(p[i] == fixed_assignments[i] for i in fixed_assignments):
        # Check if the queens do not attack each other
        if all(abs(p[i] - p[j]) != abs(i - j) and p[i] != p[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)):
            # Print the solution
            print(p)
            break
else:
    # If no solution is found, print 'UNSATISFIABLE'
    print('UNSATISFIABLE')
